title: Hello Fall canoe dude
text: Hello Fall canoe dude. This is just adorable and perfect with the small Fall tree I purchased separately (tree has LED lights) - it's quite adorable.  Measures about 7" or so long - about 4 or 5" tall.  Resin, quite weighty but not too heavy.  Fall colors - canoe says "Hello Fall" on it.  Love it.  I believe if I don't drop it - it will last for many seasons.  Having said all of that,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: One Holiday Way Rustic Woodland Character Figurine in Canoe with Hello Fall Saying and Accents - Autumn Tabletop, Desk, Mantel, Shelf Decoration - Thanksgiving Country Home, Office, Classroom Decor
features: CHARMING 8.75-INCH FALL FIGURINE WITH WOODLAND SQUIRREL AND GNOME CHARACTERS IN CANOE will add a touch of kid-friendly, rustic country farmhouse style to your home, office or classroom this harvest season

COLLECTIBLE FALL HOME DECOR ACCESSORY is also available in two other styles – Choose from a bear and owl, gnome and squirrel, or two squirrels. Collect all three woodland forest character figurines to create a stunning autumnal display for your tabletop, desktop, kitchen counter or mantel

DETAILED DESIGN WITH FALL ACCENTS AND ENGRAVED FESTIVE SAYINGS – Each canoe ornament features pumpkin and fall leaf accents, together with one of three festive sayings – “Welcome”, “Hello Fall”, or “Give Thanks”
USE AS THANKSGIVING TABLE DECOR – Combine with other fall home decor and garlands to create a stunning centerpiece display for your table for Thanksgiving dinner
Resin. Size: 8.75” L x 3.75” W x 5.25” H
description: Create a beautiful fall or Thanksgiving display at your home, office or classroom this harvest season with this resin woodland squirrel and gnome characters in canoe figurine. Complete with pumpkins, fall leaf accents and a festive saying, this collectible fall home accessory is available in three different designs and will fit perfectly on your tabletop, mantel or desktop. Display alone as an addition to your existing fall decor, or collect all three and combine to create a welcoming seasonal display for your entryway and add a touch of rustic country farmhouse style. Resin. Size: 8.75” L x 3.75” W x 5.25” H
